## Updated

- **The Offerings page now uses the same cards as Admin > Offerings.** The
  offering list was a row of thin single-line boxes that showed either the
  description or the specialisation count, but never both. Each offering is now
  a card of the same size and shape as the admin one, showing the description
  and a `N specialisations · M requirements` line together.
- Under **All companies**, each card is tagged with the company the offering
  belongs to — matching the admin page, and making two identically-named
  offerings from different companies easy to tell apart.
